data.title: 信浓 · 罗帐深宵的极乐沉沦
data.description: 帷幔深处的锦褥之上青丝交叠，九条巨大的白狐尾将两人严密包裹成独属于彼此的秘境。信浓金色眼眸中蓄满极乐的泪水，在无休止的炙热温存中低声倾诉永恒相伴。
data.location: intimate traditional bedchamber with gossamer silk canopy
data.action: entangled in deep bedding under silk canopy, nine tails fully shielding them from outside world, silver hair intermingled, tears of ecstasy in golden eyes
data.lighting: soft flickering candlelight casting dancing shadows on silk curtains
data.mood: transcendent ecstasy, complete devotion, divine intimate bliss
data.promptProse: Tangled deeply under a silk bed canopy shielded by nine fluffy tails, Shinano sheds tears of ecstasy with flushed cheeks in passionate communion.
data.animaCaption: Shinano in transcendent ecstasy wrapped in nine tails under bed canopy.
